OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: projectIdentifier
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Single-value that uniquely identifies the project. Disaster-based projects use the convention of DR-disaster number-project number-suffix (e.g., DR-1761-0001-M) while non-disaster projects use the unique project number (e.g., FMA-PJ-10-WA-2017-006).

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: communityName
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Name of the community participating in the National Flood Insurance Program's Community Rating System (NFIP's CRS)

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: communityNumber
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Identifier assigned to the community participating in the National Flood Insurance Program's Community Rating System (NFIP's CRS).

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: hash
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: MD5 hash of fields and values of the record

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: lastRefresh
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Date the record was last updated in the API data store

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: id
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Unique ID assigned to the record that does not persist between data set refreshes
